about_the_game: Delve into the work of Steel Seed and explore the art behind the stealth-action-game. See the underground facility and how the characters came to life in the official Artbook for the game. Explore concept art, character designs, environments, early sketches, and never-before-seen visuals that trace the journey from initial ideas to the final in-game world. Each page showcases the creativity and detail that went into building the dark, immersive sci-fi setting, from the imposing underground facility to the delicate emotional nuance of its characters.
